_note: Oct 15 2026, Maurice's reuse rule. Each key is a NEW image still wanted from Artistly (docs/image-list.md). Until the file is saved in src/static/images/, build.py serves a crop of `from` (an existing photo in docs/photos.json) under the new name, with that photo's alt text. When the new image arrives, the build uses the real file and `alt` is the alt text to put in the page source.
